items.t: Pinterest Stocks Jump 5.43% as Change-of-Control Pay Moves Keep Sale Talk Alive
items.sum: New protections for the CEO and top lawyer after a takeover have powered a rally, though Pinterest has announced no sale process.

items.t: What Does Pinterest (PINS) Pay Overhaul Mean For Its Takeover Talk And Ad Push?
items.sum: Pinterest (NYSE:PINS) reworked executive compensation in November 2026, adding fresh change-in-control terms that investors read as potential takeover defenses. The company expanded its collaboration with Microsoft Advertising, bringing more visual search driven shopping ads across Pinterest's surfaces. Management highlighted the role of AI and first party data in powering the new shopping ad form

items.t: Pinterest Soars 11% in a Week as a Pay Change Sparks Takeover Talk. Is a Deal Really Coming?
items.sum: Key TakeawaysPinterest shares rose 11% in the past week after an 8-K sweetened executives’ stock awards in a sale. RBC Capital said that raises the odds of a sale and cited a new Microsoft Advertising deal, but no talks have been reported.

items.t: Can PINS's New Microsoft Advertising Deal Boost Its Competitive Edge?
items.sum: Pinterest's Microsoft partnership expands advertising access, leveraging AI and commercial-intent searches to attract brands and boost monetization.

items.t: Pinterest expands advertiser access through Microsoft Advertising
items.sum: Pinterest (PINS) last night said it is expanding advertiser access to its visual search and shopping inventory through a new integration with Microsoft (MSFT) Advertising. This will enable advertisers “to extend their existing campaigns into Pinterest’s highly engaged, mobile-centric environment. The partnership creates new opportunities for advertisers to connect with consumers as they explore id

items.t: Why Pinterest Stock Just Had Its Best Day in Over a Year
items.sum: The visual search and discovery platform has seen its share price get hammered this year amid slowing ad sales growth.
